osc_evidence.source_verified_semantics: BASIC set_goal -> OSC scaled delta; reset_goal defaults achieved, goal=achieved_pose+delta; kp150 and kd=2sqrt(kp), no interpolator.
osc_evidence.v16_angular_local_equivalent: Locally near a fixed orientation axis: 0.5*angle_error-(0.5*2+0.3)*observed_angle = 0.5*error-1.3*observed_angle; SO(3) rotations need not commute.
osc_evidence.v17_command_change: One near-goal observed damping term, bounded committed position bias; far translation retains original proportional command. Original arrival/queue/phase rules remain external.
osc_evidence.gripper_semantics: sign(grip) changes hidden desired gripper target; no small-amplitude continuous aperture guarantee. Parallel empty motion therefore certifies full 0..85mm aperture.
osc_evidence.inference_limit: The saved drift and source semantics motivate a controlled candidate; neither proves these gains improve future dynamics.

limitations: No v17 physics or closed-loop success result.
Static certificate does not cover future D2 tracking error or full-arm collision.
A rigid carried hull does not prove force closure or absence of slip.
Pure held servo does not decide whether a large-angle candidate fits remaining task budget.
